Teddiursa

Normal

Johto · Generation 2

Teddiursa is a Normal-type Little Bear Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 8.8 kg. It evolves into Ursaring. Its highest base stat is Attack (80), with a base stat total of 330.
